clauses.summary: No ReturnType<typeof X> for our own codebase

flag.name: ReturnType of a factory
flag.source:
declare const createClient: () => unknown;
export type Client = ReturnType<typeof createClient>;

flag.name: awaited ReturnType of a factory
flag.source:
declare const createClient: () => Promise<unknown>;
export type Client = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createClient>>;

allow.name: named exported type
allow.source:
export interface Client { readonly id: string }
export const createClient = (): Client => ({ id: "a" });

allow.name: ReturnType in a comment line
allow.source:
// type Client = ReturnType<typeof createClient>;
export const value = 1;

allow.name: ReturnType of a type parameter
allow.source: export type Result<Factory extends () => unknown> = ReturnType<Factory>;
